changelog: Added Records > Reactivate to review inactive records, remove unwanted rows, clear Customer is Inactive, and remove only a leading INACTIVE_ from company names before saving and verifying.
Added Reactivate retries without changing the reviewed list, fresh-state reconciliation of interrupted saves, and an empty results table after refresh.
Standardized all Stop controls, including FlowBot, with an X icon, theme-aware STOP styling, and a red hover or keyboard-focus highlight.
Completed Help Center articles and improved category navigation and Back labels; removed the unfinished Help Center notice.
Unified loading and search notices with animated dots, actual result counts, and readable sales-rep names instead of internal IDs.
Added frosted-glass material surfaces across themes and refined Standard with pearl-grey panels and subtle field and table gradients.
Added animated detail sections, selected record and rep names as headings, and hidden empty detail sections in Records Search and Hybrid Reps.
Improved record-detail tab contrast and separators across themes, including l'Cie, and corrected Merge Assistant Country dropdown visibility.
Improved Bulk Transfer option spacing, removed unwanted checkbox borders, and refined saved-field discrepancy reporting.
Made the FlowBot account email more prominent with a sign-out divider and a subtle illuminated separator.
